topic: Why I Need 47 Open Browser Tabs
premise: Dev claims every single open tab is mission-critical. Gemini reads the tab titles into evidence: two are from 2021, and one is a 4-hour lo-fi stream currently paused.
Dev argues that eating leftover cold pizza over the kitchen sink burns calories because standing upright counts as core cardio. Gemini calculates the thermodynamics of guilt.
Dev sets 6 sequential phone alarms starting at 7:00 AM. Gemini informs him that his brain has entered REM confusion and his manager is already typing in Slack.
Dev spends 25 minutes analyzing the geopolitical implications of a period after 'Cool'. Gemini calculates an 89% probability the recipient was just eating soup.
Dev watches one fitness reel at 1 AM and declares tomorrow is Day 1 of his Olympian routine. Gemini cross-references his Amazon cart containing whey protein and family-size potato chips.
Dev begins the evening with 'Feature: refactor payment routing' and ends at 4 AM with 'please work i beg you aaaaa'. Gemini reads his commit log into official court testimony.
Dev leaves a $14 ergonomic mousepad in his cart for three weeks waiting for a $1.20 coupon. Gemini points out he just spent $42 on delivery burgers while waiting.

topic: Cup Number 4: Shaking at the Screen
premise: Dev downs his fourth espresso claiming it enhances hyper-focus. Gemini notes that while his typing speed has tripled, his code currently consists of 400 misplaced semicolons.
Dev insists his inbox strategy is 'bankruptcy by volume'—if it's important, someone will call. Gemini flags that three of the unopened emails are from payroll asking where to send money.
Facing an imminent project deadline, Dev decides today is the day to color-code his desktop folders. Gemini observes that organizing garbage into symmetrical piles does not take out the trash.
Dev orders three dense technical books to 'level up' his career. Gemini scans the unopened stack and observes that knowledge does not transfer through pillows via cranial osmosis.

topic: Starting My Billion-Dollar Startup at 2 AM
premise: Dev registers a new .io domain at 2 AM for a brand new startup idea, completely abandoning his previous 8 unfinished domains. Gemini offers to set up a support group for his credit card.
